text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
It is finally time to begin once again 
this year. Heralding the start of the 
Classic races, the first hurdle of the 
Triple Tiara, the Oka Sho!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
This race will be contested over 1600 
meters at Hanshin Racecourse. It's sure to 
be a battle of pure speed, but... what's 
your take on this year's Oka Sho?

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
"At this stage, having just entered the 
Classic Class, the Umamusume have little 
race experience. There will be times where 
pure talent carries the day."

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
And so! The one I'm keeping an eye on this 
year is— the "Prodigy," Admire Groove!

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: —My enthusiasm for the race, you ask?

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
"There is no such thing... All I do is 
win."

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
When I saw her race as a child, I 
shivered—she was truly a prodigy!

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
I often hear rumors about promising 
youngsters, but she's top class even among 
them! And now, she's finally entering the 
Twinkle Series!

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
“An ultra-ultra-ultra promising prospect, 
the likes of which are rarely seen! If 
it's her, she might even achieve the 
Triple Tiara, the first since 
Ramonu-san...! She is truly that gifted!”

text_block_list.name: Race Fan A
text_block_list.text:
She really is the heavy favorite. Looks 
like Admire Groove's got this race totally 
dominated, huh?

text_block_list.name: Race Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Still, there's one more girl on my mind. 
No real reason... just a feeling.

text_block_list.name: Race Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Ah, umm... I always forget the name every 
time... Oh, that's right!

text_block_list.name: Race Fan B
text_block_list.text: —Still in Love!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Seeing her so nervous reminds me of her 
Make Debut. Back then, she was terrified 
of letting her instincts show.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: ...Yes.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"There will surely be... so many more 
people here than ever before."

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"To lay myself bare... in front of such 
people..."

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: ...Ngh, ... I'm... scared...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: ...Still. I won't run away...!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: I want to win. I just... have to... so...!
choice_data_list:
It's okay. If it's you... you'll be just 
fine!

Don't worry. If it's you... you'll be just 
fine!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Trainer...!
choice_data_list: First, the first crown. Go claim it!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Yes...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Waaaaah...!!!)

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: ...Ngh.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
(Is this... the fever of the Tiara 
route...! ...Ngh, I'm losing... my 
focus...)

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Whoa!? Here it comes! Heeyyyyyy!!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Admire Groooove~~!! Groove-saaaan!!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
(Incredible... Alve-san is already drawing 
that much cheering...)

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
(...No one even noticed I came out, yet... 
She is truly such a glamorous person—)

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: (...Wait! Is it coming this way...!?)

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: Still-san.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes...!

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: I—I won't lose to anyone.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: In other words, to you too. ...That's all.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Ah...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
(Alve-san... Why are you treating me like 
an enemy...?)

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: (...I'm scared. Even so...――)

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: It sends chills down my spine...♪

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
...Ngh, no. Please... please, stay modest, 
okay...?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Now, I wonder. ...Hehe, I can't get enough 
of this... this atmosphere!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Ardent gazes... swirling fighting 
spirit... overwhelming excitement directed 
at me! Ahh...!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: I can't wait!! Let's get started!
